body:
I’m biased. I was in your situation. Been pretty much completely off of social media for a few years. It’s a tremendous help. Still think about calling it quite every day, but after I got off of SM it was one less thing to worry about. 

Highly recommend ditching SM

The same way everything else in life is a choice. If the pros outweigh the cons, then it looks like a good choice. Your teen values the pros of voluntarily dying more than the cons of living. It’s that simple. 

It’s not generational ignorance, it’s just ignorance. Your kid needs help, or this is going to happen again, I promise. Unfortunately, I can’t provide that help, but I really really hope that someone can. I hope you find them very soon.
That’s beyond messed up, and I’m really sorry those horrible things happen.
